items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: A lot of violinists, cellists, sopranos, you know, like, ooh, Sigeti, Heifetz, Francescati. Well, naturally, anyone who does play in a symphony orchestra gets to see all those people, you know.

ctx.x: Did you work with any great guest soloist?

Oh, yes. Of course. Oh, I can't remember all of them. A lot of violinists, cellists, sopranos, you know, like, ooh, Sigeti, Heifetz, Francescati. Well, naturally, anyone who does play in a symphony orchestra gets to see all those people, you know.
What would they like? How did they impress you?
